body.name: Sequential weighted random isolation law
body.construction: For \(\pi\in\Omega\), \(P_{\ell}(\pi)=\prod_{r=1}^{n}h_{\ell,\pi_r}/\bigl(\sum_{s=r}^{n}h_{\ell,\pi_s}\bigr)\); scan \(\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_n\) and put a vertex in \(S_{\ell}(\pi)\) exactly when it has no previously selected neighbor in \(C_G\).
